name: Witch's Revelation Case
description: The case Barbeloth once carried has found its way into your possession. Within it sleep all the oracles, both those already revealed and those yet to open their eyes. Whether their words may one day steer the course of fate... Barbeloth would only say this: "Hehehe... The true colors of fate are never meant to be revealed lightly. Besides, a future with secrets yet to unfold is far more delightful, would you not agree?"
